svg.title: telegram-message-exporter - deleted from Telegram doesn’t mean gone
svg.desc: A stack of encrypted cache pages drawn as byte noise. A read head steps down them, and each chunk it lifts resolves into a chat bubble that settles left or right in a transcript, while the oldest bubble is filed into html, md and csv exports.
svg.text: soakes · unofficial, offline chat recovery for macOS

text.tspan: Decrypts a copy of the db_sqlite cache, fully offline,
and exports chats as html, md or csv with cached media.
